title: Portfolio Web Application
instructions: Build a multi-page React application that consumes a public API, includes at least one form with validation, is fully responsive and is deployed to a public URL. Submit a ZIP of the repository and include the live link in your note.

title: Campaign Plan for a D2C Brand
instructions: Prepare a 30-day campaign plan including audience, channels, creative concepts, budget split and KPIs. Submit as PDF.

title: Sales Analytics Case Study
instructions: Analyse the provided sales dataset, identify three actionable insights and submit a notebook with charts and a one-page executive summary.

title: Site Audit Report
instructions: Audit a website of your choice and submit a prioritised list of 15 SEO fixes with expected impact.

title: Brand Identity Kit
instructions: Design a logo, colour palette, type system and three applications for the provided client brief. Submit as PDF.

title: Deploy a Containerised App
instructions: Containerise the sample application, deploy to AWS and submit the public URL plus your pipeline configuration.

title: End-to-End ML Project
instructions: Train a model on the provided dataset, document your evaluation and deploy it as an API. Submit the repository ZIP and a short report.

title: Mobile App Prototype
instructions: Design a 6-screen mobile app prototype for the provided brief and submit a Figma share link plus a PDF export.
